feature migrate to k8s (#3)

* Remove GitLab CI and disable DB migration and deploy in GitHub Actions

* Add environment variable checks to scheduled tasks

ArchiveTask, SendSMSTask, and WaybillTraceTask now check environment
variables to determine if they should run. GenerateOrderImageTask is
commented out as the business requirement is no longer needed.

* Refactor GitHub Actions workflows: update checkout action to v6 and add production deployment workflow
